name: Cloister at The Boca Raton
insider_take: This Mediterranean-inspired paradise sits on 200 pristine acres where old Hollywood glamour meets modern luxury, just steps from some of Florida's most exclusive beaches.
whats_special: The Cloister is part of the legendary Boca Raton resort that first opened in 1926 as architect Addison Mizner's crown jewel. The property features the only private beach club in Boca Raton, accessible via a scenic tunnel under A1A. The resort's signature pink façade has welcomed celebrities, presidents, and royalty for nearly a century.
pro_tip: Book a sunset dinner at the Beach Club's oceanfront restaurant – the views are spectacular and you'll avoid the crowds that gather later in the evening.
dont_miss: The world-class Spa Palmera with its signature pink sand beaches treatment, and a round of golf on the resort's two championship courses designed by legends like Joe Lee. Take the complimentary shuttle to explore Mizner Park's upscale shopping and dining scene.
pros: Historic luxury resort with elegant Mediterranean architecture
Prime beachfront location with private beach access
Exceptional dining options and award-winning restaurants
cons: Formal atmosphere may not suit all travelers
